create.name: Suzanne Sterling
create.bio:
Suzanne Sterling is a singer, ritual leader and voice teacher from the San Francisco Bay Area who has spent more than twenty-five years helping people find and use their own voice. Her roots are in the Reclaiming tradition of earth-based spirituality, where she has led public ritual and trained teachers since 1990, and in yoga, where she has taught on YogaWorks teacher trainings and at gatherings such as Wanderlust, Esalen, Omega and Kripalu. In 2006 she co-founded Off the Mat, Into the World with Seane Corn and Hala Khouri, a project that links yoga practice with community service and leadership.

Her own approach, the Voice of Change Method, brings together singing, breath, movement, storytelling and ritual so that students can speak and sing with more confidence and presence. She offers it through one-to-one mentoring, workshops, talks and retreats, and she also designs ceremonies for weddings, festivals and conferences. Group singing series in Oakland, classes at the Globe Institute in Sausalito and devotional concerts keep her teaching close to live music; she has released five solo albums on labels including Sounds True and White Swan. On Commune she leads the voice and action sessions of the Off the Mat leadership course.

courses.title: Redefining Leadership with Off the Mat, Into the World
courses.description: A ten-day Commune course from Off the Mat, Into the World, shared between Seane Corn, Hala Khouri and Suzanne, on self-inquiry for people who want to lead change in their communities. Suzanne teaches the closing days: working with the voice, a sound-based yoga practice and turning good intentions into a concrete plan.

courses.title: Voice of Change 1:1 Mentorship
courses.description: Private mentoring in Suzanne's Voice of Change Method, using song, breath, movement and story to help you speak and express yourself more freely. Suited to individuals as well as leaders, founders and educators who want to communicate with more presence; a short info call can be booked first.

courses.title: Ritual Arts 1:1 Mentorship
courses.description: One-to-one guidance in designing and leading ritual, drawing on Suzanne's three decades in the Reclaiming tradition and earth-based spirituality. It looks at ritual as a way to mark change, build community and connect with the sacred.

courses.title: Ritual Design for Special Events
courses.description: Suzanne creates and leads ceremonies made for a particular gathering, from weddings and festivals to short moments of focus at conferences and talks. Each one is shaped around the purpose of the event and the people attending.

free_resources.title: Rise Up Singing
free_resources.description: A free twenty-minute video practice with a written guide, using rhythm, voice, movement and simple ritual to wake up creativity and self-expression. Sign-up is by name and email.

free_resources.title: Ritual to Ignite your Intuition
free_resources.description: A free short video workshop with a guide that uses movement, sound and ritual to practise listening to your inner sense of direction. It is meant as a simple routine to come back to when making decisions.

flags: Also on The Shift Network faculty list (the-shift-network-faculty.json, course 'Create Healing Rituals to Release Trauma & Invoke Joy, Empowerment & the Sacred', older); the-shift-network added to teaches_at. That course title is trauma-framed and is not listed here.

Possible overlap: the Commune course is shared with Seane Corn (already listed) and Hala Khouri (rank 25, skipped); its Day 7 session by Hala Khouri is titled 'How Trauma Shapes Us'. The course sits in Commune's Impact category, not Health, and Suzanne's own days are about voice and action, so it is kept; a human may prefer to drop it.
The Commune course is social-activism themed (justice, leadership, 'systems'); I judged it non-partisan. Her own Action page uses similar language.

City set to Oakland: her site gives no home address, but her regular in-person teaching is in the Bay Area (Embodied Singing series in Oakland, Globe Institute classes in Sausalito, concerts in Berkeley).

Her site describes her as 'a respected expert on sound and sound healing' and she is on faculty at the Globe Sound Healing Institute; sound-healing is used as a subject for her voice work, but the Globe certificate classes (sound therapy) are not listed.

Voice of Change and Art of Ritual online courses are marked 'coming in 2025' on her site and do not exist yet; the mentorship 'Learn More' link (/mentorship) is a 404, so the mentorship items point to the Voice of Change and Art of Ritual pages.
She is also a recording artist (five albums, kirtan); concert and music-only videos are left out.
